name: Agent database setup planner
why: Plans a schema map, migration steps, access rules and a staging test, the same order as the schema design skill.

name: Agent database migration planner
why: Plans a change that keeps existing data, with staging checks, release order and recovery steps, a companion to the production migration workflow.

name: Build a backup recovery rehearsal
why: Gives a restore test plan, checklist and evidence log, the paperwork side of the backup and restore drill.

name: Recovery rehearsal evidence assistant
why: Checks restore test evidence against recovery targets and assigns owners to the gaps found in a drill.

name: Connect Code to Supabase coding prompt
why: Connects an app to Supabase with scoped access, safe secrets and a read check, a safe first step before any schema work there.

name: Plan Oracle to Postgres with proof
why: Scopes a move to PostgreSQL with baseline tests, for clients changing databases rather than tables.

name: Release manager
why: Gives a go or no-go, rollback plan and live check for a release that carries a migration.

name: Excel table join reconciler
why: Reconciles two tables on their keys and shows unmatched and duplicate rows, the same fan-out checks a report query needs.

name: Database schema designer
why: Drafts tables, links, indexes and rules from an app description, a quick first pass to check against the business rules.

name: Data warehouse query reviewer
why: Reviews a business question or SQL for join and privacy errors with a read-only plan, close to the SQL skill's checks.

name: Database backup setter
why: Sets up full, incremental and point-in-time backups, which the restore drill then proves.
